quickref.status: BBR v1.3.2 (2012), 4-round lob. Became ~20 rounds (28 with gear) after SkyVu's Apr 25, 2014 Oliver Overhaul, through at least Aug 2018. Back to 4 by Jun 2021. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Squat Daruma jug: white face, black brows, dark neck, tan rope loop. From behind: dark-maroon faceted body (~#66181A) with yellow-outlined red-orange flame decals (~#EC4727) and a round emblem. About 0.3x a bear.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lob era: non-damaging arcing shot (wiki); never seen in flight. 2014-18 version: a cream splash crown (~#DFD7BE) spurts from the neck with white droplets (DxHcbyg9oPg).
quickref.impact_end_result: Chunky cream puffs (~#D5BBAD) and white ovals engulf the target. A glossy lime '?' with a separate dot (~#51A406-#61E51A) floats over victims, including the thrower. Controls reversed 4 s, music cut. 2018: white puffs and flat white splats. 2021: lime spike splash (~#9AFE31), attribution inferred. No damage.

quickref.status: BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014), Gas item. HUD x/1 in 2014-2016. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Long silver blade held upright in the right hand, rising above the head (~1.0-1.2x), dark-and-gold/orange hilt. HUD icon: sword with gold-orange guard.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: One swing launches a long, thin, tapered, slightly curved flame-textured orange crescent (~#EB7F0D, core #F69520) that flies straight. Wiki: passes through walls (not observed).
quickref.impact_end_result: Struck bears get a yellow disc (~#FBCC0B) with six black spokes and a black centre over the head (radiation stage icon), plus Geiger clicks; 100 RP = explosion (wiki). The 'dark, circular radiation belt' is unseen.

quickref.status: BBR v1.3.1 week 1 (2012), 30 Gas. Fan-titled in 2026 (9nA-OaYAVzU) but not visible there.
quickref.look: Brass steampunk shotgun: green glass dome in a brass cage, two copper stacks with green gems, silver rod barrel, gold honeycomb muzzle disc (2018 demo render).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Wiki: 'a quick spread of damaging green steam'. No frame shows it firing: sDVr1PqEHC4, _JeiI0KrSbA and 9nA-OaYAVzU frames show other weapons.
quickref.impact_end_result: Unknown. The steam colour (green vs white) is unverified.

quickref.status: Default since BBR v1.0. HUD 1 (2013), 3 (Mar 2014), 4 (Aug 2014; Jul 2015 with Ammo +2). Named on Steam 2026; seen in the Steam trailer (2013 footage [Inference, strong]).
quickref.look: Coral hex shoulder tube with glowing orange panels and grey hex collars. The muzzle end has a pink hex cap around a dark bore, with a grey-coral checker band right behind the cap. About 0.7x long.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Launch: a burst of round grey smoke puffs and a dotted grey puff trail (2015). Steam-trailer rocket (2013 footage), in flight 1.92-3.05 s: grey hex nose, glowing orange panels (~#FFAF0E), red-studded rear collar, spiky orange flame tail; it leaves the frame without detonating (Bearzooka link Inference, high).
quickref.impact_end_result: 2014-15 fan footage: a faceted yellow polygon blast with a grey or dark-grey smoke ball (Bearzooka link Inference, high). The Steam trailer (2013 footage) shows no Bearzooka blast: its yellow fireball is the B-1000's own jet leap, and the rocket passes under him (shared.addendum.md, round 3). 2015: grey puff cloud downrange. Self-damage documented ('very prone to suicide').

quickref.status: BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014), 45 Gas. HUD x/130 in 2014 vs wiki 80 (100 max with gear); 100/100 in 2016. Nerfed after release.
quickref.look: Dark gunmetal three-barrel gun (HUD icon dark green). Not clearly seen in third person in these frames.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Thin white-cream tracer streaks from gun to target.
quickref.impact_end_result: Big cream-white starburst (core ~#FAF4DA) with long pale-peach rays (~#F4CF9E) swallowing the target. The magenta arcs seen around the gun are the Bearscream Sandwich buff, not the weapon.

quickref.look: Silver-white HASR retexture with a dark gunmetal ring loop.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Soft magenta muzzle glow (~#F43AD2); small magenta dots/bolts in flight (bolt reading inferred). 2026 Sci-Fi ASR also fires magenta orbs.
quickref.impact_end_result: Magenta-pink orb burst with white core (~#FE7CFC) on the struck bear (2016). Yellow stars and bars in Jan 2014. 'Button' function undocumented.

quickref.firing_and_projectile: Tiny white-yellow sparkle flecks at the muzzle (2017); no tracer seen.
quickref.impact_end_result: No attributable hit frame (2021 magenta flashes are confounded by a magenta-firing enemy).

quickref.status: BBR v1.3.2 (2012). 4/5 in Jan 2014. x/20 in SkyVu's official Oliver Overhaul video (Apr 25, 2014); 20 or 28 with gear through Aug 2018. 4 (+gear) by Jun 2021. Listed in the 2026 Closed Playtest #4.
quickref.look: Squat dark-maroon faceted jug (~#471D15) with yellow-outlined red-orange flame decals, held at the right shoulder. The reload flip shows a white Daruma face, black brows and a round red emblem with a gold kanji-like mark. Tan rope loop. About 0.3x his height.

quickref.impact_end_result: Grey smoke puffs (~#888987), then cream puff chunks (~#E1DCE0) swallow the target. A glossy lime '?' with a separate dot (~#6BB058) appears over or under the victim's name. Controls reversed 4 s, music cut (wiki). No damage. It can hit the user.

quickref.status: BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014), Gas item. Ammo 1. Listed in the 2026 playtest with identical description text and a RADIATION stat.

quickref.firing_and_projectile: One swing launches a long, thin, tapered, slightly curved flame-textured orange crescent (~#E47D10, core ~#F59A10) that flies straight, diagonally up from his right side. Passing through walls is not seen.
quickref.impact_end_result: A yellow disc (~#E7C038) floats overhead and loses a growing wedge as radiation builds (Irradiated icon; Geiger clicks per wiki). 100 RP = explosion of 150-200 units (wiki). The 'dark, circular radiation belt' is unseen.

quickref.status: BBR v1.3.1 week 1 (2012), 30 Gas. Ammo 3. Listed in the 2026 playtest with identical description text.

quickref.impact_end_result: A white puff with pink flecks on the target after a shot (2013 thumbnail; attribution inferred). Whether the steam lingers is unknown.

quickref.status: Default since BBR v1.0. HUD 1 (2013), 3 (Mar 2014), 2 in SkyVu's overhaul (Apr 2014), 4 with Ammo+2 (2014-15). Named on Steam 2026; in the Steam trailer (2013 footage [Inference, strong]); in the 2026 playtest (stats ~60 explosives / 250 AoE / 1.5 cooldown / 2.5 reload).
quickref.look: Coral hex shoulder tube (~#9F5D5E) with glowing orange-yellow panels. Pink hex muzzle cap around a dark bore, checker band behind the cap. About 0.6-0.7x. Same design 2013-2026; NOT the green hazard-striped BB Zombies tube.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Launch: round grey smoke puffs and a dotted grey puff trail. Rocket (Steam trailer, 2013 footage, 1.92-3.05 s; Bearzooka link Inference, high): grey hex nose, glowing orange and yellow square panels, grey collar and fin, spiky orange-yellow flame tail; it leaves the frame without detonating.
quickref.impact_end_result: A faceted yellow polygon blast (~#F7E04F-#F8EB6F) with a grey or dark-grey smoke ball (2014-15 fan footage; Bearzooka link Inference, high). No official media show the blast: the Steam trailer's yellow fireball (2013 footage) is the B-1000's own jet leap, not a Bearzooka hit (shared.addendum.md, round 3). Easy to kill yourself (2026 class card).

quickref.status: BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014), 45 Gas. x/130 in 2014 vs wiki 80 (+20 max); nerfed later. Listed in the 2026 playtest.
quickref.look: Dark gunmetal three-barrel gun (verified dossier); unclear in third-person frames.
